corpus: Only H3 verified-contextual/fingerprint-v1, current reward/features/scenario signature. Deduplicate exact IDs/earned samples; conflicting ID or same actor+sample with different identity/data is fatal. Gaps allowed, never backfill legacy. Local archive path is actor-scoped, hash pinned and offline only; no automatic DB read or remote input.
fit: Chronological and curriculum use the SAME unique examples exactly once, ridge I and unchanged6D/reward. Expect near order-invariance; no claims of curriculum improvement from floating point. Report validation prediction agreement and MSE per seed; tolerance max prediction difference1e-8.
policy: Frozen curriculum-fitted synthetic replay prior, k5 prediction blend with personal per-action sample count; only while total earned personal samples<24. Thereafter exact personal baseline. No prior matrices/counts/skills/memory installed into actors. Hard guards and personal uncertainty unchanged. Warm-only cutoff is a new pre-registered hypothesis motivated by H4, not a retune on old seeds.

gates.entropy: paired holdout CI95 lower bound of candidate - .8*baseline >=0

primary: 20 untouched holdout seeds per profile, candidate versus personal. No adaptive tuning or promotion. Validation is prediction-only and does not select parameters.
acceptance: actor filtering before replay, strict schema/signature/context, corruption/conflict rejection, duplicate replay no additional confidence
input/archive preservation, no DB/network/runtime policy writes, private model outputs only ignored directory
deterministic corpus order/digest/model/artifact, input SHA and source labels; SHA is integrity not external authentication
one pass replay counts are not earned samples, source role history is not inferred, frozen prediction after warm cutoff matches baseline
full units/typecheck/lint/build/API local, H1 golden/full report unchanged, deterministic full replay/candidate repeats
limits: Existing8-level dialogue curriculum is separate; no SFT/DPO/LLM fine-tune or generated experience credit.
Ridge order-invariance means a sorted curriculum alone should not improve the final model.
Archive actor provenance is an operator-supplied local source with H3 consistency checks, not authenticated physical/social evidence.
No archive/history deletion, memory backfill, role-at-choice reconstruction, production installation or policy namespace migration in this phase.
